comment: Read from src/Reflection.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. The fold and the wrap are both written as recursions with a hard stop after ten passes (Reflection.cpp:26 and 41), so a signal far enough outside a narrow window is returned still outside it; the panel gives no sign of that, though a lamp does light when the recursion runs. The Inverted output is not an inversion of the Main output: the input is negated first and then folded, which on an off-centre window gives a different shape rather than a mirror image. The Mirror Type button has no printed label, only two glyphs. There is no manual for this module and no README entry. The module has no right-click menu of its own, so no panel-colour choice.
